element.name: Reduce Identity Sprawl Across the SAP Landscape
Improve Security Posture and Reduce Attack Surface
Ensure Compliance with Access Governance Policy
Achieve Single Source of Identity Truth (Azure AD)
Automate User Provisioning to the SAP Landscape
Lower Help Desk Ticket Volume for Password Resets
Fixed Compliance Deadline for Access Governance
No Direct Write-Back from SAP Systems to Azure AD (One-Way Sync)
Production Identity Data May Not Flow to Non-Production Environments
